content:
A Chinese leaker with a reasonably solid track record recently posted several images claiming to be schematics of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.

These images suggest that the new A20 Pro chip may feature seven GPU cores—one more than the previous generation—along with a faster memory interface…

The images posted by Weibo user "Fried White Rice" are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather diagrams showing where the chip is soldered onto the underlying circuit board. From these, they have inferred the chip's performance and architecture, arriving at two main conclusions about possible upgrades.

Firstly, the diagrams show that the CPU core configuration remains the same as last year—six cores in total: two high-performance cores and four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to have an increased amount of cache memory.

It is not easy to determine the number of GPU cores from the limited information provided by the solder point diagrams—six, seven or eight are all possible. However, they have concluded that seven cores is the most likely configuration.

Fixed Focus Digital previously noted that the A20 Pro chip would be 18% faster than its predecessor, with a 30% improvement in power efficiency.

9to5Mac Take

This Weibo account does have a certain degree of credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is ultimately quite speculative. While the conclusions they reached seem reasonable on the surface, one should not treat them as definitive proof, but rather as informed speculation.
